# mimecast_profile_groups (Data Source)

Read all profile groups with cursor pagination and deterministic ordering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_profile_groups" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Group description.
- `group_count` (Number) Child group count.
- `id` (String) Profile group ID.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent group ID.
- `source` (String) Group source.
- `user_count` (Number) Direct user count.
